description:
Live UMG at runtime: inspect, create and change on-screen widgets, HUD text without assets, world labels, and the
activity panel. Widgets are addressed by "widget:Name" (top-level or unique names) or by the `target` that every
result returns (pass it directly).
Workflow: list_widgets -> get_widget_description (one line per widget, index-aligned refs) -> set_text /
set_widget_visibility / set_brush, or edit the tree (add_widget, move_widget, wrap_widget, remove_widget).
create_hud_text shows text without a widget asset; create_label tags things in the world. All edits are undoable
except click_button.
name: ui

tools.description:
Adds a new widget as a child of a panel in a live widget tree. Undoable.
Returns: The new widget. Fails if the parent is not a panel or is full, or the class is not a widget class.

child_index.description: Position among the parent's children (-1 = last).

parent.description: Panel widget target, e.g. a CanvasPanel or VerticalBox from get_widget_description.

widget_class.description: Widget class, e.g. "TextBlock", "Button", "Image", "VerticalBox". (Class name or path (a Widget))

tools.name: ui.add_widget

returnValue.description: The new widget. Fails if the parent is not a panel or is full, or the class is not a widget class.

class.description: Widget class, e.g. TextBlock, Button, CanvasPanel.

depth.description: Depth below the listed root (0 = root).

panel.description: Whether the widget is a panel (can take children: add_widget, move_widget).

parent.description: Parent panel's target, empty for a root widget.

path.description: Full object path (always accepted as a target).

target.description: Pass this directly as `target`, `parent` or `widget` to other ui tools: "widget:Name" for top-level widgets, the object path otherwise.

returnValue.title: RuntimeWidgetInfo

tools.description:
Puts a name tag in the world: text drawn above a target (as its child node, so it follows it) or at a location. Undoable.
Returns: The label node. Fails if neither target nor location is given.

location.description: World location [x, y, z] when there is no target. ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Node or actor to label (placed above its top centre), e.g. "n12". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

returnValue.description: The label node. Fails if neither target nor location is given.
